# Apogee: a Plotform studio edition

Dated 2026-09-17. This is an authored adaptation, not an unmodified upstream template and not an additional independently sourced repository.

## Foundation

Moon Landing (astro-landing-page), https://github.com/mhyfritz/astro-landing-page, pinned revision 987617a50863d31bb865ee531391a191d74a878a, MIT, copyright 2022-present Markus Hsi-Yang Fritz. The upstream is vendored at `vendor/templates/modern-moon` and archived inside `source.zip` under `upstream/`. Its MIT notice is kept in `licenses/moon-landing-MIT.txt`.

## What was reused

- The dark page architecture: a header with wordmark, navigation and a switcher control, a full-width splash, stacked content sections and a footer.
- The CSS custom-property theme approach (`src/styles/theme.css`), rewritten as the `:root` token set at the top of `style.css`.
- The theme switcher, reworked as the product finish toggle (Graphite / Bone) on the home page.
- The lunar photograph `src/assets/moon.jpg`, a NASA photograph from Unsplash credited in the Moon Landing README, copied unchanged to `assets/moon.jpg` and used once on the principles page.

## What was not reused

Astro, Tailwind and the npm toolchain; the starfield canvas; the gradient headline; the feature-card grid; the compatibility list and showcase; the GitHub corner; the astronaut image (its origin repository is no longer available, so its provenance could not be verified); all Astro copy, logos and showcase screenshots.

## What is new

Every page's layout, typography, copy and responsive behaviour; the SVG drawings of the illustrative product (two finishes, four detail views and the rear panel), generated by `tools/make-svgs.mjs` in the vendored source; and the JavaScript (finish toggle, mobile navigation dialog, sticky step index, changelog expand-all). The new work is licensed MIT (`LICENSE`).

## Typography

DM Sans, SIL Open Font License, bundled locally as `assets/dm-sans.woff2` with its license in `licenses/dm-sans-OFL.txt`. No remote fonts, scripts, trackers or forms. Contact links open the visitor's email application with the example address `hello@example.com`; replace it before publishing.

## Content

Deck is an illustrative product. Its specifications, firmware versions, version names and dates are examples, not a real device or real releases. Each page says so in a demo note. No prices, metrics, download counts, customer names or testimonials appear anywhere.

## Design direction

The direction takes cues from the user's references (an oversized headline broken around a product visual, numbered sections with thin rules, a designed footer ending). No reference site code, imagery or branding is included.

## Building

The site is static: open `index.html` through any static server. The five pages are assembled by `tools/build-pages.mjs` and the drawings by `tools/make-svgs.mjs` in the vendored source (`vendor/templates/studio-launch`); both are plain Node scripts with no dependencies. Editing the HTML directly also works.
